summary: Cisapride was taken off the market in the United States and 14 other countries starting in the year 2000 because of heart harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave the drug medium risk scores for both liver and heart problems [M]. Additionally, a similar drug named Metoclopramide carries a boxed warning in the United States for heart harm as well as nerve and brain harm [4].
